messages:
Maya Chen: heads-up, PR #8841 canary (tiling + kv-cache tweak) is showing a p95 tail bump on longseq runs. attaching bench artifacts — can someone give quick eyes? :eyes:

Oliver Park: pinging bench owners. what's the delta numbers?

Maya Chen: p50 roughly the same, p95 +18% (220ms -> 260ms) on 4k seq. throughput steady across canary vs baseline. host RSS memory +8%. bench artifacts: https://bench.internal/redwood/176801 

Priya Rao: thanks. can you paste the exact bench command + config so we can reproduce locally? curious about batch_horizon and prefill settings.

Maya Chen: sure — repro command + config below:

```
./run_bench --model=redwood-4k --seq=4096 --batch=12 --tiling=on --kv-shards=8 --iters=120
# config snippet
batch_horizon = 3
prefill = true
```

Ava Summers: tiling changes the prefetch/prefill path; that can definitely affect tail if prefill overlaps with kv-shard fetches. bench-bot: run summary attached.

bench-bot: benchmark run completed: samples=120, p50=118ms, p95=260ms, p99=420ms, variance=0.03. artifacts uploaded: s3://bench-artifacts/176801/canary-stdout.log

Oliver Park: p95 delta ~40ms is non-trivial. recommend blocking merge until we confirm whether it's config sensitivity or a regression in tiling code path. can you run microbench with batch=1 and batch=24 to check horizon sensitivity?

Maya Chen: running the microbench variants now (batch=1 / 12 / 24). I'll post the micro results and a diff of allocation traces shortly.

Priya Rao: also looping in @eng-platform — scheduler/alloc changes were touched in the same PR, so want their eyes on placement noise.

Maya Chen: @eng-platform added to the PR and pinged in their channel. will update within 30m :hourglass:

Ava Summers: if this ends up being a perf regression, please capture the exact commit hash and a blamelist so release can revert cleanly. also note any canary-only config differences.

Maya Chen: ack. committing bench diffs and linking artifacts in the PR now. thanks all :rocket:
